data.explanation: This is your passport (marked SPECIMEN). It expires on 10 February 2027, about four months from now. Renew it in good time through your country's embassy or consulate, because a residence permit and travel often depend on a valid passport. Check whether your residence permit (Aufenthaltstitel) needs an updated passport, and ask the immigration office (Ausländerbehörde) if unsure.
